pages.text: The $(item)Core Monitor$() shows an energy core's numbers from anywhere, even another dimension.$(br2)Panels facing the same way join into one screen, up to 4 by 4. Bigger screens show more: a graph from 3 by 2, stat cards and a live picture of the core on 3 by 3 and 4 by 4.

pages.title: Linking
pages.text: Take a $(item)Crystal Binder$(), Shift-right-click the core (or a stabilizer or pylon), then right-click any panel. Panels added later join on their own.$(br2)A far core only updates while its chunk is loaded; the screen then shows the last values and how long ago.

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: Right-click a panel with an empty hand.$(li)$(l)Display$(): what the screen shows, unit, warning and alarm levels, graph range, background.$(li)$(l)Control$(): turn the core on or off; preview the next tier.$(li)$(l)Pylons$(): each pylon, its rate and mode, and rate limits.

pages.title: More settings
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Options$(): name, ETA target, alerts (chat, toast, sound, team; switching one on sends a TEST), redstone output, locate.$(li)$(l)Stats$(): averages, peaks and a graph over 5 minutes, 1 hour or 24 hours.$(br2)Only the player who linked it and operators can change settings.

pages.title: Finding things
pages.text: The pin next to a pylon, and $(l)Locate core$(), outline that block through walls for 30 seconds (click again to stop) and put its position in chat as a JourneyMap waypoint.$(br2)With CC: Tweaked the monitor is the peripheral $(l)draconic_monitor$().

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: Each panel can give a signal: the fill level (0-15), on below the alarm level, on while full, or on while draining.
